National Silicon Industry Group.evidence: National Silicon Industry Group investor Q&A (09-11-2026): H1 2026 revenue and 300mm wafer sales volume grew; its 300mm, 200mm-and-below products have won business opportunities at major overseas customers

players.product: 300mm silicon wafers (Zing Semiconductor), 300mm SOI wafers (Simgui) and MEMS/specialty wafers (Okmetic)

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive that in H1 2026 both revenue and 300mm wafer sales volume grew, but it is still loss-making, mainly because wafer prices remain low after several years of industry downturn: volume grew strongly but price recovery has not yet fully passed through to profit; some new capacity projects are basically built and entering product qualification and gradual ramp, so higher depreciation weighs on operating profit, as do R&D spending and exchange-rate moves. It will keep ramping capacity, raising its prime-wafer ratio and optimising its product mix.

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive that the global silicon-wafer market showed a structural recovery in H1 2026: after 300mm wafer prices kept falling in 2023-2025, the domestic wafer market stabilised in H1 2026 and gradually entered an upward channel; some products that had been cut heavily have begun price repair and some products in strong demand have room for price increases; the company is actively pursuing price optimisation and negotiations by product specification, application and customer.

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive that it has stepped up R&D on high-end 300mm silicon wafers and 300mm SOI; as results convert, its range of volume-production specifications keeps widening and some high-end products have built strong technical depth and a degree of pricing power. It will keep raising the share of prime wafers and high-spec products and its capacity utilisation.

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive that its 300mm, 200mm-and-below product lines have all won business opportunities at major overseas customers, and it is pushing hard into overseas markets on top of its domestic base.
